5 Electrical Safety Tips from Your Trusted Tacoma Electrician

As your trusted electrician in Tacoma, Washington Electrical LLC is dedicated to keeping homes in Tacoma, Puyallup, and Lakewood safe, efficient, and up to code. Our family-owned electrical company believes that safety begins with knowledge — and a few simple precautions can prevent thousands of dollars in damage or even save lives.

1. Check Your Electrical Panel Regularly

Your electrical panel is the heart of your home’s system. Look for signs of rust, burning smells, or flickering lights — these can signal overloaded circuits or outdated breakers. If your panel is older than 20 years, it may be time for an upgrade to handle modern electrical demands safely.

2. Avoid Overloading Outlets

Plugging too many devices into one outlet or power strip can cause overheating or fire hazards. Spread appliances across multiple outlets, and use surge protectors when charging electronics or running high-demand devices like space heaters.

3. Replace Damaged Cords and Outlets

Frayed wires or cracked outlets are a hidden danger that can lead to shocks or electrical fires. Replace any damaged cords immediately, and have a licensed electrician repair or replace unsafe outlets — especially those that spark or feel warm.

4. Keep Water Away from Electricity

Never touch electrical devices with wet hands or operate them near sinks, tubs, or outdoor water sources. Install GFCI outlets (ground-fault circuit interrupters) in bathrooms, kitchens, and garages to prevent shocks in damp areas.

5. Schedule Professional Inspections

Even if your home seems fine, routine inspections by a licensed Tacoma electrician can catch potential hazards early. Our technicians at Washington Electrical LLC ensure your wiring, grounding, and panel connections meet all Washington state codes.

At Washington Electrical LLC, we’re proud to serve Pierce and South King County homeowners with safe, reliable, and professional residential electrical services — from panel upgrades and rewiring to EV charger installations.
Your family’s safety is our top priority — contact us today for a free quote or electrical inspection in Tacoma, Puyallup, or Lakewood.

Reliable Residential Electrical Services

Our team provides a full range of residential electrical work across the South Puget Sound region. From lighting installation and panel replacements to EV charger setups and safety inspections, we handle every project with precision and care. We know how important it is to have dependable power in your home, and we’re here to keep it running smoothly year-round.

  • Tacoma: We specialize in wiring repairs, lighting upgrades, and whole-home safety inspections.

  • Puyallup: Homeowners trust us for expert panel upgrades, circuit breaker replacements, and outlet installations.

  • Lakewood: When the power goes out or you face urgent electrical issues, our team responds quickly with 24/7 emergency electrician service.

Why Homeowners Choose Washington Electrical

Choosing the right electrician matters. Here’s why local residents continue to rely on Washington Electrical LLC:

  • We know Tacoma, Puyallup, and Lakewood neighborhoods and electrical codes inside and out.

  • Our licensed electricians provide honest pricing and clear communication every step of the way.

  • We’re a family-owned business built on integrity, reliability, and quality workmanship.

  • Our 24/7 emergency electrician in Tacoma ensures fast response times when you need us most.

From simple troubleshooting to full electrical remodels, we’re here to serve you with professionalism and care. Contact Washington Electrical LLC today to schedule your service or request a free quote anywhere in Pierce County.

The house features light tan horizontal siding, a dark grey shingled roof with multiple gables, and decorative brick pillars framing the garage. An asphalt driveway leads to an open two-car garage containing a blue SUV, a bicycle, and various storage items. The front yard is neatly landscaped with a vibrant green lawn, several shrubs, and a prominent deciduous tree to the left of the walkway.
item.excerpt:encoded: A well-maintained residential home featuring a mix of siding and brick accents, complete with a lush green lawn and an open garage.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: A tan two-story suburban house with a two-car garage, a dark front door, and a paved driveway under a blue sky.

item.title: Salisbury Class 2 Rubber Insulating Gloves
item.dc:creator: ruslan
item.content:encoded: This high-angle shot shows a pair of heavy-duty black rubber insulating gloves on a distressed wooden workbench. The left glove is positioned face-up, clearly showing white printed safety specifications including "Class 2," "Max Use: 17,000V AC," and "Tested: 10/23." The right glove shows the textured palm for grip. Both gloves feature a rolled cuff with a bright red interior lining. In the background, scattered tools like a marker, electrical tape, and screws are visible, suggesting an industrial or electrical workshop environment.
item.excerpt:encoded: Salisbury Class 2 electrical safety gloves rated for up to 17,000V AC, displayed on a technician's wooden work surface.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: A pair of black rubber electrical insulating gloves with red interior lining resting on a worn wooden workbench.

item.content:encoded: This side-by-side comparison shows the dramatic impact of professional lighting design. Initially, the kitchen relied on a single outdated "boob" light. However, Washington Electrical LLC upgraded the space with dimmable recessed cans, under-cabinet lighting, and stylish pendant accents, all fully compliant with WA State L&I safety codes.
item.excerpt:encoded: From dim to dazzling: A complete kitchen lighting overhaul in Washington featuring layered LED task and ambient lighting.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Before and after of a kitchen lighting remodel featuring new recessed ceiling lights, under-cabinet LEDs, and three modern black pendant lights over a white island.

item.title: Car Charging in Modern Garage
item.dc:creator: ruslan
item.content:encoded: A wide-angle evening shot of a contemporary Pacific Northwest home featuring a red car parked inside an open garage. The electric vehicle is plugged into a sleek, glowing wall-mounted charging station. The background showcases dense pine forests and a snow-capped mountain range under a twilight sky.
item.excerpt:encoded: Sustainable luxury meets modern design with home EV charging.

item.title: Knob-and-tube-install
item.dc:creator: ruslan
item.content:encoded: Washington Electrical provides knob-and-tube wiring replacement and whole-home electrical upgrades for older homes. Our licensed electricians remove outdated wiring, improve safety, increase electrical capacity, and bring electrical systems closer to modern code standards throughout Tacoma, Lakewood, Puyallup, Federal Way, and surrounding areas.

Hire a Licensed Electrician in Fife

Trusted Local Electrician Near You in Fife

Get a Quote!

Lighting the Way

[grw id=2061]

Electrician in Fife! Licensed, Local & Family-Owned

Need a licensed electrician in Fife to replace knob-and-tube wiring or upgrade outdated electrical? That’s what we do. We’re a small electrical company based in Fife, proudly serving our community since 2023. We upgrade older wiring to modern, code-compliant systems — clean work, minimal drywall damage, and done right the first time. We treat our customers like family and work through any project big or small. Senior and military discounts available.

Panel Upgrades

We specialize in electrical panel upgrades in the Tacoma area. Whether you need a full service upgrade, a Zinsco or Federal Pacific panel replacement, or a smart SPAN panel installation — we handle it all. Safe, clean, and fully code-compliant.

EV Charger

Whether you need help installing an EV charger, making room in your panel, or just want to know how much it costs — we’ve got you covered. EV charger installations start at $799. Clean, Safe, and done right the first time.

Lighting Upgrades

Whether you’re installing a custom fixture from Seattle Lighting, replacing a light that’s high up on a ceiling, or mounting a heavy chandelier — we specialize in these types of installs.

Need to add recessed cans for more light in a room? We handle it cleanly and professionally, and we treat every home like it’s our own.

Wiring Upgrades

Still have knob-and-tube wiring? We specialize in safely upgrading older electrical systems to modern, code-compliant wiring.

Whether you’re remodeling, adding new circuits, or replacing outdated or unsafe wiring, we’ll evaluate your home and upgrade it properly. Clean work, minimal drywall damage, and done to today’s standards.

Outlet Install

Sparking outlet? Loose plug? Breaker keeps tripping?

We install and replace outlets safely and up to code — including GFCI, USB, tamper-resistant, and dedicated circuits. Whether it’s a bad connection or you need new outlets added, we’ll get it fixed cleanly and professionally.

Service Call

Need an electrical diagnostic? We offer service calls starting at $195 for a full diagnostic of your home’s electrical system.

We’ll identify the issue, explain it clearly, and fix it properly — taking the stress out of your electrical worries. Most service calls are completed within a 2-hour window, and we leave homeowners impressed with both the solution and the workmanship.

item.title: FAQ
item.dc:creator: ruslan
item.content:encoded:
Frequently Asked Questions

Welcome to Washington Electrician’s Most Asked Questions page! Do you have problems like lights that flicker, breakers that trip, or an old electrical panel? We’ve got answers to your top questions. Our friendly electricians are here to keep your home in Washington safe and powered up. Check out our FAQs below or ask for a quote for our expert electrical help today!

Common Electrical Questions Answered

Why do my lights flicker?

Flickering can indicate issues like loose bulbs, faulty wiring, or overloaded circuits.

How do I reset a tripped circuit breaker?

Locate your circuit breaker panel, find the tripped breaker, and flip it fully off before turning it back on.

What are the signs that I need to upgrade my electrical panel?

For instance frequent tripping breakers, outdated equipment, or a lack of capacity for modern appliances can indicate the need for an upgrade.

What should I do if an outlet isn’t working?

First, check if the circuit breaker is tripped, ensure the outlet isn’t damaged, and test it with a multimeter.

What are the signs of overloaded circuits?

For example, frequent tripping of breakers, warm outlets, or flickering lights can indicate overload.

What is a GFCI outlet, and where should I install one?

Ground Fault Circuit Interrupters (GFCIs) protect against electrical shock and should be installed in wet areas like kitchens and bathrooms.

What should I do if a circuit breaker keeps tripping?

Identify the cause, like overloaded circuits or short circuits, and consider consulting an electrician if the problem persists.

Is it safe to use extension cords for a long time?

No, extension cords are meant for temporary use. For permanent solutions, install more outlets.

When should I replace old wiring?

If your home has outdated wiring (like aluminum or knob-and-tube), shows signs of wear, or if you’re renovating, it may need replacing.

Learn more about us.

TACOMA RESIDENTIAL ELECTRICIANS

Need a Licensed Electrician Near Me in Tacoma? Trust Our Family-Owned Residential Experts 

Get a Quote!

Lighting the Way

[grw id=2061]

Meet Your Trusted Tacoma Electricians – Family-Owned and Licensed Near You

Searching for an electrician near me in Tacoma? Washington Electrical LLC, a family-owned local electrician services company, proudly serves the Tacoma area with licensed electrical contractor expertise you can rely on. From routine electrical service company support to emergency help from electrical contractors near me, we deliver professional, tailored solutions. Reach out today for top-notch residential wiring specialist service from your trusted local electrical crew.
Panel Upgrades

Panel Change Services Near Tacoma, WA

If your electrical panel is outdated, overloaded, or malfunctioning, Washington Electrical LLC provides expert panel change services. Upgrading your panel ensures safety, efficiency, and the ability to handle modern electrical demands. We prioritize your safety by adhering to the highest industry standards, including those outlined in the NFPA 70 National Electrical Code. Quality and compliance are at the heart of every project we undertake.

EV Charger

EV Charger Installation Near Tacoma, WA 

Looking to install an EV charger at your home or business? Washington Electrical LLC provides expert EV charger installation services. Our skilled electricians ensure a safe, efficient setup for your electric vehicle, helping you keep your car charged and ready to go. Trust us for reliable and professional EV charger installations near Tacoma. Considering an EV charger for your home? Discover electric vehicle charging basics at Energy.gov’s Alternative Fuels Data Center.

Lighting Upgrades

Lighting Upgrade Services Near Tacoma, WA

Enhancing your lighting is about transformation. Imagine a dim room now filled with warm light—it sparks creativity and connection. The right lighting uplifts your spirit and changes how you feel in your space. Embrace this journey and watch your space brighten.  Discover ways to save energy with efficiency options at Energy.gov.

Wiring Upgrades

A wiring upgrade enhances safety and efficiency in your home. Older wiring can cause flickering lights or overloads. Upgrading ensures your system meets modern demands, from high-powered appliances to smart devices. This investment boosts safety and energy efficiency, transforming your space into a more reliable environment.

Outlet Install

Installing new outlets enhances your space and boosts convenience. Imagine charging devices or powering appliances without messy cords. A well-placed outlet transforms functionality, whether in the kitchen or living room. This simple change can make your environment more efficient and inviting. Embrace it and see the difference!

Service Call

An electrical service call ensures safety and functionality in your home. If you notice flickering lights or circuit issues, it’s essential to call a professional. Electrician will diagnose the problems and handle repairs, preventing future issues and giving you peace of mind. Trusting an expert keeps your space safe and functional.

item.title: Ev Charger
item.dc:creator: ruslan
item.content:encoded:
Professional EV Charger Installation by Licensed Electricians

Why You Need a Licensed Electrician to Install EV Charger Near Me

Get a Quote!

Lighting the Way

[grw id=2061]

Need a reliable electrician to install an EV charger? Our certified experts provide safe, efficient, and code-compliant installations for peace of mind.

Improper EV charger installation can lead to safety risks and costly repairs. Our certified electricians ensure a safe, code-compliant install you can trust.

According to Dr. Electric, common DIY mistakes include incorrect wiring and inadequate power supply, which can result in malfunctions or even fires.

Panel Upgrades

Upgrading your electrical panel may be necessary to support an EV charger. Our team ensures your home’s system is ready for the added power needs, providing a safe and efficient upgrade.

 

EV Charger

We specialize in installing EV chargers, ensuring a safe and seamless setup that works with your home’s electrical system, giving you the convenience of charging your electric vehicle at home.

Lighting Upgrades

Along with upgrading your electrical system for an EV charger, consider enhancing your lighting. We can install energy-efficient lighting solutions that complement your new setup.

Wiring Upgrades

If your wiring is outdated, an upgrade is essential for proper EV charger installation. We ensure your home’s electrical system can handle the additional load without issues.

Outlet Install

Need a dedicated outlet for your EV charger? We provide professional outlet installation to ensure your vehicle charges efficiently and safely without overloading circuits.

Service Call

Having issues with your EV charger? Our service calls are quick and reliable, diagnosing and fixing any problems to keep your system running smoothly.

 Visit our About Us page to learn more.

Request a Quote Today

[wpforms id="2023"]

Reach Us

Contact Information

Email: Service@Washingtonelectrical.net

Call: (253) 234-5359

Text: (253) 234-5219

 

Business Hours

Monday - Friday: Open 24 hours

Saturday - Sunday: Closed

Call Now!

item.title: Lighting Installation
item.dc:creator: ruslan
item.content:encoded:
Light Installation Services for Your Home

Why Choose Washington Electrical for Your Light Installation?

Get a Quote! [grw id=2061]

Our Light Installation Services

We offer a wide range of light installation services to elevate your space, from modern recessed lighting to elegant chandelier installation. Whether you're updating a single room or planning a full lighting upgrade, our expert electricians deliver safe, efficient, and stylish solutions for any space.

Panel Upgrades

When it comes to panel upgrades, it's important to ensure your electrical system can handle the demands of modern devices. Along with a panel upgrade

EV Charger

We offer professional EV charger installation to ensure your home or business is ready for electric vehicles. 

Lighting Upgrades

Whether you're looking for recessed  or a chandelier, our installation upgrades are designed to transform your space. We recommend choosing ENERGY STAR-certified lighting for maximum efficiency and long-term savings.

Wiring Upgrades

Outdated wiring can impact your lighting installation and overall electrical system. With our wiring upgrades, we ensure your wiring is safe and ready for new install, allowing you to upgrade your space with confidence.

Outlet Install

Our outlet installation service ensures your space is equipped with the proper outlets for your Home and any other electrical needs. Whether it's installing additional outlets or upgrading existing ones, we provide solutions that enhance both convenience and safety.

Service Call

Need immediate help with your electrical issues? Our service call provides fast solutions for everything from lighting installation to electrical repairs, ensuring your home or business stays safe and well-lit.

 Visit our About Us page for a free consultation.

Request a Quote Today

[wpforms id="2023"]

Reach Us

Contact Information

Email: Service@Washingtonelectrical.net

Call: (253) 234-5359

Text: (253) 234-5219

 

Business Hours

Monday - Friday: Open 24 hours

Saturday - Sunday: Closed

Call Now!

item.title: Tube and Knob Wiring
item.dc:creator: ruslan
item.content:encoded:
Home Electrical Upgrades by Expert Residential Electricians

Trusted Home Electricians Specializing in Knob and Tube Wiring for Local Homeowners

Get a Quote! [grw id=2061]

Affordable Residential Electrician Services for Knob and Tube and Home Electrical Upgrades


Washington Electrical LLC provides cost-effective electrical upgrades for homeowners. Our skilled residential electricians offer high-quality services like panel upgrades, rewiring, and troubleshooting at competitive prices, ensuring your home is safe and efficient.


What to Expect

When replacing knob and tube wiring, we work circuit by circuit whenever possible to keep power available throughout your home and minimize disruptions to your daily routine. Our team specializes in tube and knob wiring replacement and uses modern tools, cameras, and fishing techniques to run new wiring with minimal damage to walls and ceilings.

 

How Long does it Take

The time required for a knob and tube wiring replacement depends on the size and layout of the home. For a typical 2,000-square-foot house, a complete tube and knob wiring rewire usually takes about two weeks. We will provide a detailed timeline before work begins so you know exactly what to expect.

 

Lighting Upgrades

Many homeowners choose to upgrade their lighting while replacing knob and tube wiring. This is a great opportunity to add recessed lighting, install new fixtures, or upgrade to energy-efficient LED lighting. Modern lighting can improve comfort, increase home value, and reduce energy costs.

 

Friendly Upgrades

We understand that plans can change during a project. That’s why we work closely with homeowners throughout the knob and tube wiring replacement process to ensure the final result meets their needs and expectations.

 

Outlet Install

Our knob and tube wiring replacement package includes installing outlets to meet modern NEC spacing requirements. Instead of simply replacing existing outlets, we add enough receptacles to make your home safer, more convenient, and better suited for today’s electrical needs.

Panel Upgrade

Replacing knob and tube wiring is often the perfect time to upgrade your electrical panel. A modern panel can safely handle today’s power demands, improve electrical safety, reduce overload risks, and provide capacity for future additions such as EV chargers, heat pumps, and hot tubs.

 Visit our About Us page for a free consultation.

Electric Companies Near Me - Top Electrical Services

Find Reliable Electrical Services in Your Area

Get a Quote!

Lighting the Way

[grw id=2061]

Benefits of Local Electrical Services

Looking for top electrical services? Our electric company near you delivers expert solutions, from panel upgrades to EV charger installations. Trust our licensed electricians for safe, reliable repairs and upgrades tailored to your home’s needs, ensuring efficiency and peace of mind.

Panel Upgrades

Is your panel outdated? Our electric company near you offers panel upgrades to improve your home’s power capacity. Our reliable solutions ensure safer, more efficient electricity, preventing outages.

EV Charger

Are you in need of an EV charger? Our electrician services make charging electric vehicles easy. As a local electric company, we install EV chargers quickly, ensuring safe, convenient power at home. Trust our skilled team for fast, high-quality work.

Lighting Upgrades

Need to upgrade your lighting to save energy. Our nearby electric company installs efficient lights, improving ambiance and cutting costs. Enjoy brighter, smarter lighting tailored to your home with expert care

Wiring Upgrades

Wiring upgrades services ensure safe wiring upgrades. As a trusted electric company near you, we update old systems, boosting performance and preventing risks. Our skilled team provides reliable fixes customized for your home.

Outlet Install

Outlet installation solutions add convenience. Our local electric company places new outlets carefully, improving your home’s functionality. Count on our expert electricians for quick, high-quality work tailored to your needs

Service Call

Do you need a service call? We can help. As an electric company near you, we diagnose and repair problems quickly, ensuring safety and reliability. Trust our dedicated team for excellent care every time.

 Visit our About Us page for a free consultation.

Request a Quote Today

item.content:encoded: 5 Electrical Safety Tips from Your Trusted Tacoma Electrician As your trusted electrician in Tacoma, Washington Electrical LLC is dedicated to keeping homes in Tacoma, Puyallup, and Lakewood safe, efficient, and up to code. Our family-owned electrical company believes that safety begins with knowledge — and a few simple precautions can prevent thousands of dollars in damage or even save lives. 1. Check Your Electrical Panel Regularly Your electrical panel is the heart of your home’s system. Look for signs of rust, burning smells, or flickering lights — these can signal overloaded circuits or outdated breakers. If your panel is older than 20 years, it may be time for an upgrade to handle modern electrical demands safely. 2. Avoid Overloading Outlets Plugging too many devices into one outlet or power strip can cause overheating or fire hazards. Spread appliances across multiple outlets, and use surge protectors when charging electronics or running high-demand devices like space heaters. 3. Replace Damaged Cords and Outlets Frayed wires or cracked outlets are a hidden danger that can lead to shocks or electrical fires. Replace any damaged cords immediately, and have a licensed electrician repair or replace unsafe outlets — especially those that spark or…

item.content:encoded:
Local Residential Electrician in Federal Way

Need a Licensed Electrician near Federal Way? Trust Our Family-Owned Experts

Get a Quote!

Lighting the Way

[grw id=2061]

Meet Your Trusted Electrician in Federal Way, WA – Family-Owned and Licensed

Looking for a great electrician in Federal Way? We are Washington Electrical LLC, a family-owned business. As a licensed electrical contractor, our main job is keeping your home safe. Many older houses have old electrical boxes (called Federal Pacific or Zinsco panels) that can be unsafe. We take those out and put in safe, new ones! We do everyday electrical repairs, and if you ever need fast emergency support, we can usually fix the problem in just 2 hours! Our customers are super happy with our fast work. Visit our About Us page to meet our family crew!

Panel Upgrades

Panel Change Services Near Federal Way, WA

Many homes in our area have old Zinsco or Federal Pacific electrical boxes. These can be dangerous because they get too hot and might start a fire. At Washington Electrical LLC, we have already replaced many of these panels in Federal Way to keep families safe. We follow all the safety rules (like the National Electrical Code) to make sure your new panel works perfectly. A new panel means your lights stay on and your home stays safe! 

EV Charger

EV Charger Installation Near Federal Way, WA 

We provides safe and professional EV charger installation near Tacoma. Our electricians install efficient electric vehicle chargers, often without needing a panel upgrade, and we work with many types of homes and electrical systems. Puget Sound Energy (PSE) may offer rebates and programs that can help lower the cost of EV charger installation. You can learn more about available incentives here

Lighting Upgrades

Lighting Upgrade Services Near Federal Way, WA

Whether you’re installing a custom fixture from Lamps Plus, replacing a light that’s high up on a ceiling, or mounting a heavy chandelier, we specialize in these types of installs. Need to add recessed can lights to brighten up a room? We handle lighting installs cleanly and professionally. As a local electrical company serving Federal Way

Wiring Upgrades

A wiring upgrade enhances safety and efficiency in your home. Older wiring can cause flickering lights or overloads. Upgrading ensures your system meets modern demands, from high-powered appliances to smart devices. This investment boosts safety and energy efficiency, transforming your space into a more reliable environment.

Outlet Install

Installing new outlets enhances your space and boosts convenience. Imagine charging devices or powering appliances without messy cords. A well-placed outlet transforms functionality, whether in the kitchen or living room. This simple change can make your environment more efficient and inviting. Embrace it and see the difference!

Service Call

An electrical service call ensures safety and functionality in your home. If you notice flickering lights or circuit issues, it’s essential to call a professional. Electrician will diagnose the problems and handle repairs, preventing future issues and giving you peace of mind. Trusting an expert keeps your space safe and functional.

item.title: About Us
item.dc:creator: ruslan
item.content:encoded:
About Electrician in Fife, Washington – Your Trusted Local Electrical Company

Services Fife Since 2023​

Meet Ivan, our skilled electrician.

Ivan is a licensed electrician at Washington Electrical LLC in Fife, Washington. He has over a decade of electrical experience in things like replacing electrical panels and backup generators, installing EV chargers, and helping with home remodel projects for folks in Pierce County. Ivan’s knowledge of the current electrical code makes sure all the electrical work is safe.

Ivan enjoys spending time with his family and kids, and he works really hard for them. Being part of the Fife community, Ivan takes every project really seriously, treating it with care and dedication.

Meet Russ, our dedicated electrician

Let me introduce Russ, who’s the owner of Washington Electrical LLC, a trusted electrician for homes in Fife, Washington. Russ specializes in electrical panel replacements, and if you live in Pierce County, he can help you. Russ has been doing electrical work for over 6 years. He’s friendly and really focuses on customers to make sure his work is safe, reliable, and follows the latest guideline for NFPA 70 National Electrical Code.

Russ is honest and precise, and he’s good at explaining electrical work. He takes pride in creating solutions that make your home’s electrical system safer and more efficient. Russ treats every house like it’s his own. You can make Washington Electrical LLC your choice for your electrical work in your home.

Why choose Washington Electrical?

We’re just a small company, based right here in Fife, and we’re proud to be the local electrical folks people trust. Our goal—our mission—is to provide reliable electrical services that put customers first. We try to be professional, safe, honest, and trustworthy. Our Fife electricians are skilled, and they really care about not wasting your time and making sure you have a great experience.

We started out as hardworking electricians who mostly worked on homes, driven by this passion for doing great work for our community. We’re not a big corporation just trying to sell our electrical services but a local electrical company wanting to make a difference right here in our neighborhood.

We offer electrical solutions.

Our electrical team in Fife are experts at providing real solutions, like fixing electrical problems, installing lights, or upgrading panels. We've got years of know-how, and we try to keep up with the latest industry practices to make sure the work is reliable, safe, and fits what you need.

Serving Fife and Surrounding Areas

We’re really proud to call Fife, Washington, our home. We proudly provide expert electrical services in Fife as well as nearby cities including Tacoma, Milton, Puyallup, and surrounding areas. Thank you for choosing Washington Electrical LLC. Please, contact us today.

Request a Quote Today

Reach Us

Contact Information

Email: Service@Washingtonelectrical.net

Call: (253) 234-5359

Text: (253) 234-5219

 

Business Hours

Monday - Saturday: Open 24 hours

Sunday: Closed

We started out as hardworking electricians who mostly worked on homes, driven by this passion for doing great work for our community. item.content:encoded:
Electrical Services in South King & Pierce County | Washington Electrical LLC

Welcome to Washington Electrical LLC, your trusted, local electricians serving South King County and Pierce County. Our licensed and insured team delivers top-quality residential electrical services with a focus on safety, reliability, and customer satisfaction. Whether you need routine repairs, emergency electrician services, or advanced installations, we’re here to keep your home powered and safe.

Our Residential Electrical Services

  • Electrical panel upgrades and sub-panel installation
  • Knob and tube wiring
  • Circuit breaker installation and replacement
  • Outlet and switch repairs/replacements
  • Lighting installation and upgrades
  • Ceiling Fan Installation
  • Electrical repairs and troubleshooting
  • Surge protection installation
  • Hot Tub or Pool Wiring
  • Smoke & Carbon Monoxide Detector Installation
  • Emergency electrical services
  • Electric Vehicle (EV) Charger Installation

Why Choose Washington Electrical LLC?

When it comes to electrical services, Washington Electrical LLC stands out as a trusted choice for homeowners and businesses alike. Here are the key reasons to choose us for your electrical needs:

1. Experienced and Licensed Professionals

Our team consists of highly skilled, licensed electricians with years of experience in handling a wide range of electrical projects. From simple repairs to complex installations, we bring expertise and precision to every job.

2. Commitment to Safety

Safety is our top priority. We adhere to strict safety standards and comply with all local codes and regulations to ensure that every project is completed safely and reliably, giving you peace of mind.

3. Quality Workmanship

At Washington Electrical LLC, we take pride in delivering high-quality work. Whether it's wiring, lighting installation, or panel upgrades, our attention to detail ensures long-lasting results that meet or exceed industry standards.

Here are some of the areas we provide services to:

  • Seattle

  • Tacoma

  • SeaTac

  • Kent

  • Renton

  • Federal Way

  • Auburn

  • Lakewood

  • Puyallup

  • University Place

  • Bonney Lake

  • Edgewood

  • Gig Harbor

  • Sumner

  • Fife

  • DuPont

  • Burien

  • Milton

  • Des Moines

  • Maple Valley

Request a Quote Today

[wpforms id="2023"]

Reach Us

Contact Information

Email: Service@Washingtonelectrical.net

Call: (253) 234-5359

Text: (253) 234-5219

 

Business Hours

Monday - Friday: Open 24 hours

Saturday - Sunday: Closed

Call Now!

item.title: Contact Us
item.dc:creator: ruslan
item.content:encoded:
Contact Washington Electrical

Thank You for Reaching Out to Washington Electrical! We’re thrilled that you chose Washington Electrical LLC, your trusted team of residential electricians proudly serving the Pacific Northwest — from Tacoma and Puyallup to Lakewood and beyond. Our mission is simple: to keep your home safe, efficient, and beautifully powered. Whether you need help fixing faulty wiring, upgrading your electrical panel, or installing modern, energy-saving lighting, our skilled electricians bring precision and care to every job. We also specialize in EV charger installations, helping homeowners make the switch to clean, convenient electric driving without the hassle. At Washington Electrical, we believe great service starts with genuine connection. You’ll never deal with pushy sales tactics or confusing estimates — just honest advice, upfront pricing, and work done right the first time. As a family-owned local business, we treat every customer’s home like our own, ensuring your electrical system runs safely for years to come. If you’re curious about how we can improve your home’s power, comfort, or efficiency, we’d love to chat. ? Call Washington Electrical today for a free quote or friendly expert advice — and see why homeowners across Pierce and King County trust us to light the way.

Lear more about panel upgrades.

Request a Quote Today

[wpforms id="2023"]

Reach Us

Contact Information

Email: Service@Washingtonelectrical.net

Call: (253) 234-5359

Text: (253) 234-5219

 

Business Hours

Monday - Friday: Open 24 hours

Saturday - Sunday: Closed

Local Residential Electrician in Auburn

Need a Licensed Electrician near Auburn? Trust Our Family-Owned Experts

Get a Quote!

Lighting the Way

[grw id=2061]

Your Reliable, Family-Owned Licensed Electrician in Auburn, WA

If you're looking for a trusted electrician in Auburn, WA, Washington Electrical LLC is your go-to solution. As a family-owned and fully licensed electrical services company, we bring the perfect mix of local expertise, personalized service, and professional reliability.

Why Choose Us? Because You Benefit From:

  • Peace of Mind: Licensed, insured, and experienced electricians who get it right the first time.

  • Fast, Reliable Service: We show up on time and complete the job efficiently—no long waits or repeat visits.

  • Fair and Clear Pricing: We provide upfront quotes with no unexpected charges, ensuring you know exactly what to expect

  • Tailored Solutions: Whether it’s a simple switch repair or an EV charger installation, we offer options that fit your needs and budget.

  • Emergency Support: We’re here when you need us most—quick response times you can count on.

  • Safety First: All work is done to code, ensuring your home or business is protected for the long term.

From everyday electrical repairs to complex upgrades, we’re here to make your life easier, safer, and more energy efficient.

Ready to work with a local team that puts you first? Visit our About Us page to learn more or contact us today for a free estimate.

Local Residential Electrician in Kent

Need a Licensed Electrician near Kent? Trust Our Family-Owned Experts

Get a Quote!

Lighting the Way

[grw id=2061]

Looking for a licensed Kent electrician? Washington Electrical LLC provides trusted, family-owned electrical services, including wiring, lighting, and panel upgrades across Kent, WA.

If you're looking for a reliable electrician in Kent consider Washington Electrical LLC. As a family-owned electrician services company, we proudly serve near Kent area our licensed electrical contractor expertise that you can trust. Moreover, from routine electrical repairs to emergency support provided by skilled electrical contractors in Kent we deliver professional, tailored solutions designed to meet your specific needs. For instance, customers have praised our timely and efficient service, such as installing circuit breakers, fixing switches, and even setting up EV chargers with clear explanations of options. Additionally, our commitment to safety and affordability shines through in reviews, with one client noting a pleasantly lower-than-expected invoice after extensive work. Therefore, to learn more about our top-notch  local electrical crew, visit our about us page today.

Panel Upgrades

Panel Change Services Near Kent, WA

If your electrical panel is outdated, overloaded, or malfunctioning, Washington Electrical LLC provides expert panel change services. Upgrading your panel ensures safety, efficiency, and the ability to handle modern electrical demands. We prioritize your safety by adhering to the highest industry standards, including those outlined in the NFPA 70 National Electrical Code. Quality and compliance are at the heart of every project we undertake.

EV Charger

EV Charger Installation Near Kent, WA 

Looking to install an EV charger at your home or business? Washington Electrical LLC provides expert EV charger installation services. Our skilled electricians ensure a safe, efficient setup for your electric vehicle, helping you keep your car charged and ready to go. Trust us for reliable and professional EV charger installations near Tacoma. Considering an EV charger for your home? Discover electric vehicle charging basics at Energy.gov’s Alternative Fuels Data Center.

Lighting Upgrades

Lighting Upgrade Services Near Kent, WA

Enhancing your lighting is about transformation. Imagine a dim room now filled with warm light—it sparks creativity and connection. The right lighting uplifts your spirit and changes how you feel in your space. Embrace this journey and watch your space brighten.  Discover ways to save energy with efficiency options at Energy.gov.

Wiring Upgrades

A wiring upgrade enhances safety and efficiency in your home. Older wiring can cause flickering lights or overloads. Upgrading ensures your system meets modern demands, from high-powered appliances to smart devices. This investment boosts safety and energy efficiency, transforming your space into a more reliable environment.

Outlet Install

Installing new outlets enhances your space and boosts convenience. Imagine charging devices or powering appliances without messy cords. A well-placed outlet transforms functionality, whether in the kitchen or living room. This simple change can make your environment more efficient and inviting. Embrace it and see the difference!

Service Call

An electrical service call ensures safety and functionality in your home. If you notice flickering lights or circuit issues, it’s essential to call a professional. Electrician will diagnose the problems and handle repairs, preventing future issues and giving you peace of mind. Trusting an expert keeps your space safe and functional.

Lighting the Way

Meet Your Trusted Electrician in Seattle, WA – Family-Owned and Licensed

If you're looking for a reliable electrician in Seattle consider Washington Electrical LLC. As a family-owned electrician services company, we proudly serve near Seattle area our licensed electrical contractor expertise that you can trust. Moreover, from routine electrical repairs to emergency support provided by skilled electrical contractors in Seattle we deliver professional, tailored solutions designed to meet your specific needs. For instance, customers have praised our timely and efficient service, such as installing circuit breakers, fixing switches, and even setting up EV chargers with clear explanations of options. Additionally, our commitment to safety and affordability shines through in reviews, with one client noting a pleasantly lower-than-expected invoice after extensive work. Therefore, to learn more about our top-notch  local electrical crew, visit our about us page today.

Panel Upgrades

Panel Change Services Near Seattle, WA

If your electrical panel is outdated, overloaded, or malfunctioning, Washington Electrical LLC provides expert panel change services. Upgrading your panel ensures safety, efficiency, and the ability to handle modern electrical demands. We prioritize your safety by adhering to the highest industry standards, including those outlined in the NFPA 70 National Electrical Code. Quality and compliance are at the heart of every project we undertake.

EV Charger

EV Charger Installation Near Seattle, WA 

Looking to install an EV charger at your home or business? Washington Electrical LLC provides expert EV charger installation services. Our skilled electricians ensure a safe, efficient setup for your electric vehicle, helping you keep your car charged and ready to go. Trust us for reliable and professional EV charger installations near Tacoma. Considering an EV charger for your home? Discover electric vehicle charging basics at Energy.gov’s Alternative Fuels Data Center.

Lighting Upgrades

Lighting Upgrade Services Near Seattle, WA

Enhancing your lighting is about transformation. Imagine a dim room now filled with warm light—it sparks creativity and connection. The right lighting uplifts your spirit and changes how you feel in your space. Embrace this journey and watch your space brighten.  Discover ways to save energy with efficiency options at Energy.gov.

Wiring Upgrades

A wiring upgrade enhances safety and efficiency in your home. Older wiring can cause flickering lights or overloads. Upgrading ensures your system meets modern demands, from high-powered appliances to smart devices. This investment boosts safety and energy efficiency, transforming your space into a more reliable environment.

Outlet Install

Installing new outlets enhances your space and boosts convenience. Imagine charging devices or powering appliances without messy cords. A well-placed outlet transforms functionality, whether in the kitchen or living room. This simple change can make your environment more efficient and inviting. Embrace it and see the difference!

Service Call

An electrical service call ensures safety and functionality in your home. If you notice flickering lights or circuit issues, it’s essential to call a professional. Electrician will diagnose the problems and handle repairs, preventing future issues and giving you peace of mind. Trusting an expert keeps your space safe and functional.

Bonney Lake Electrician — Professional Panel Upgrades & Electrical Services

Bonney Lake Electrician — Professional Panel Upgrades & Electrical Services

Get a Quote!

Lighting the Way

[grw id=2061]

Looking for a trusted Bonney Lake electrician? Washington Electrical LLC is a family-owned company providing expert residential services, lighting installation, EV charger setup, and panel upgrades in Bonney Lake, WA.

Explore our BBB Business Profile for reviews, ratings, and accreditation.

Visit our Service Area page to see all locations we serve, including Tacoma, Bonney Lake, and surrounding neighborhoods.

Get in touch through our Contact Us page to request a quote or schedule service.

Panel Upgrades

Panel Change Services Near Bonney Lake, WA

If your electrical panel is outdated, overloaded, or showing signs of wear, Washington Electrical LLC offers professional panel upgrades in Bonney Lake, WA. As a trusted residential electrician, we deliver modern, code-compliant solutions that enhance safety, reliability, and energy capacity.

Our upgrade services strengthen your electrical system, supporting additional needs like home wiring, lighting installations, and EV charger setups. Every project follows the NFPA 70 National Electrical Code, ensuring the highest level of safety and compliance for your home.

EV Charger

EV Charger Installation Bonney Lake, WA 

Installing an EV charger provides the convenience of charging your vehicle at home or on-site, saving you time and hassle. It allows for faster, more efficient charging—especially with Level 2 systems. Adding a charger can also increase your property’s value and appeal to eco-conscious buyers or tenants. Over time, you'll benefit from lower fueling costs and contribute to a more sustainable future.

 
  
 
Lighting Upgrades

Lighting Upgrade Services Near Bonney Lake, WA

Brighten your Bonney Lake home with professional lighting installation from Washington Electrical LLC—your trusted local electrician. Transform dim, outdated spaces into warm, inviting areas that inspire comfort and creativity.Our electrical services include customized lighting layouts designed for both beauty and efficiency. Pair your lighting upgrade with panel improvements, wiring updates, or EV charger installation for a complete home electrical refresh.For helpful tips on lighting efficiency, visit Energy.gov.

Wiring Upgrades

Upgrade your Bonney Lake, WA home with expert wiring services from Washington Electrical LLC. A wiring upgrade enhances safety, reduces overload risks, and ensures your home keeps up with modern electrical demands—from smart devices to high-powered appliances.

Our residential wiring services in Bonney Lake can be paired with lighting installation, EV charger setup, or panel upgrades for a reliable, energy-efficient electrical system. This investment helps create a safer, more dependable home environment.

Outlet Install

Enhance your Bonney Lake home with professional outlet installation from Washington Electrical LLC, your trusted neighborhood electrician. Adding new outlets improves convenience and functionality throughout your home, letting you power devices and appliances without clutter or extension cords.

As part of our full-service electrical offerings, we place outlets strategically to fit your lifestyle—whether in kitchens, living rooms, or garages. Combine this upgrade with new lighting, wiring, or panel improvements for a truly efficient space.

Service Call

Keep your Bonney Lake home safe and functional with an electrical service call from Washington Electrical LLC. If you notice flickering lights, tripped breakers, or faulty circuits, our electricians provide expert troubleshooting and repairs to prevent bigger issues down the line.

From panel upgrades and wiring to lighting and EV charger installation, we deliver dependable service and lasting peace of mind. Count on our licensed professionals to maintain the safety and efficiency of your electrical system.

Request a Quote Today

Reach Us

Call: (253) 234-5359

Text: (253) 234-5219

 

Business Hours

Saturday - Sunday: Closed

Lighting the Way

Meet Your Trusted Sumner Electricians – Family-Owned and Licensed Near You

Searching for an electrician near me in Sumner? Washington Electrical LLC, a family-owned local electrician services company, proudly serves the Sumner area with licensed electrical contractor expertise you can rely on. From routine electrical service company support to emergency help from electrical contractors near me, we deliver professional, tailored solutions. Reach out today for top-notch residential wiring specialist service from your trusted local electrical crew.
Panel Upgrades

Panel Change Services Near Sumner, WA

If your electrical panel is outdated, overloaded, or malfunctioning, Washington Electrical LLC provides expert panel change services. Upgrading your panel ensures safety, efficiency, and the ability to handle modern electrical demands. We prioritize your safety by adhering to the highest industry standards, including those outlined in the NFPA 70 National Electrical Code. Quality and compliance are at the heart of every project we undertake.

EV Charger

EV Charger Installation Near Sumner, WA 

Looking to install an EV charger at your home or business? Washington Electrical LLC provides expert EV charger installation services. Our skilled electricians ensure a safe, efficient setup for your electric vehicle, helping you keep your car charged and ready to go. Trust us for reliable and professional EV charger installations near Sumner. Considering an EV charger for your home? Discover electric vehicle charging basics at Energy.gov’s Alternative Fuels Data Center.

Lighting Upgrades

Lighting Upgrade Services Near Sumner, WA

Enhancing your lighting is about transformation. Imagine a dim room now filled with warm light—it sparks creativity and connection. The right lighting uplifts your spirit and changes how you feel in your space. Embrace this journey and watch your space brighten.  Discover ways to save energy with efficiency options at Energy.gov.

Wiring Upgrades

A wiring upgrade enhances safety and efficiency in your home. Older wiring can cause flickering lights or overloads. Upgrading ensures your system meets modern demands, from high-powered appliances to smart devices. This investment boosts safety and energy efficiency, transforming your space into a more reliable environment.

Outlet Install

Installing new outlets enhances your space and boosts convenience. Imagine charging devices or powering appliances without messy cords. A well-placed outlet transforms functionality, whether in the kitchen or living room. This simple change can make your environment more efficient and inviting. Embrace it and see the difference!

Service Call

An electrical service call ensures safety and functionality in your home. If you notice flickering lights or circuit issues, it’s essential to call a professional. Electrician will diagnose the problems and handle repairs, preventing future issues and giving you peace of mind. Trusting an expert keeps your space safe and functional.

Des Moines electrician Professional Panel Upgrades and Electrical Services

Need a licensed electrician near you in Des Moines? Our family-owned team specializes in panel upgrades.

Get a Quote!

Lighting the Way

[grw id=2061]

At Washington Electrical, we offer a full range of electrical services tailored to Des Moines residents and businesses. Our team handles everything from small repairs to large-scale installations with precision and care.

Looking for a licensed Des Moines electrician? Washington Electrical LLC is your trusted, family-owned company providing reliable residential electrical services — including panel upgrades, lighting installation, and EV charger setup — throughout Des Moines, WA.

  Explore our BBB Business Profile for customer reviews, ratings, and accreditation details.Find out the areas we serve, including Auburn, Renton, and surrounding regions, in our Service Area page.

Get in touch with us for quotes, inquiries, or to schedule a service via our Contact Us page.​

Panel Upgrades

Panel Change Services Near Des Moines, WA

If your electrical panel is outdated, overloaded, or unsafe, Washington Electrical LLC provides expert panel upgrade services in Des Moines, WA. Our licensed electricians replace aging systems with modern, code-compliant panels that improve your home’s capacity and safety.

Each project follows the NFPA 70 National Electrical Code, ensuring every upgrade meets professional safety standards. Pair your new panel with home wiring improvements, lighting installation, or an EV charger setup for a fully modernized electrical system.

EV Charger

EV Charger Installation Near Des Moines, WA 

Planning to install an EV charger at your home or business? Our Des Moines electricians specialize in seamless, code-compliant EV charger installations that connect smoothly to your existing power system.

We can assess your current panel, determine if an upgrade is required, and complete the job efficiently. Based near Renton, Washington Electrical LLC proudly serves Des Moines and the South King County region with trusted residential electrical services.

Learn more about EV charging options at Energy.gov’s Alternative Fuels Data Center.

Lighting Upgrades

Lighting Upgrade Services Near Des Moines, WA

Transform your home’s look and efficiency with lighting upgrades in Des Moines, WA from Washington Electrical LLC. Our professional electricians design and install lighting that enhances comfort, safety, and style — from bright kitchen lighting to cozy living room fixtures.

Combine your lighting installation with wiring or panel upgrades for a complete electrical refresh. For energy-saving advice and fixture ideas, visit Energy.gov.

Wiring Upgrades

Upgrade your home wiring with Washington Electrical LLC, your trusted Des Moines electrician. Outdated wiring can cause flickering lights, tripped breakers, and safety risks — our wiring upgrades bring your system up to modern standards for reliability and performance.

We design custom wiring solutions that support today’s technology, appliances, and EV chargers. Pair your project with lighting installation or panel upgrades for a safe, energy-efficient home built to last.

Outlet Install

Add convenience to your home with outlet installation services from Washington Electrical LLC. Our Des Moines electricians install and upgrade outlets to eliminate clutter, improve access, and support your devices safely.

We strategically position outlets in kitchens, garages, and living areas, tailoring placement to your needs. Combine outlet installation with panel, lighting, or wiring upgrades for the ultimate home efficiency improvement.

Service Call

Keep your home’s electrical system safe and functional with a service call in Des Moines, WA. Our certified electricians provide quick diagnostics and repairs for flickering lights, tripping breakers, or wiring concerns — ensuring your home stays powered safely.

From panel upgrades to lighting fixes, Washington Electrical LLC delivers dependable, code-compliant solutions that restore peace of mind and prevent future issues.

Burien Electrician — Professional Panel Upgrades & Electrical Services

Looking for a reliable Burien electrician near you? Our family-owned team at Washington Electrical LLC provides professional panel upgrades and complete home electrical services throughout Burien, WA.

Get a Quote!

Lighting the Way

[grw id=2061]

At Washington Electrical, we provide comprehensive electrical services designed specifically for Burien homeowners and local businesses. Whether it’s a small repair or a full installation, our electricians handle every job with care, precision, and attention to detail.

Need a reliable electrician near you in Burien? Our licensed and insured team offers both scheduled and emergency services with dependable, long-term results. From lighting upgrades to panel changes, we ensure every project meets the highest standards of safety and performance.

Explore our BBB Business Profile for reviews, ratings, and accreditation.

Visit our Service Area page to see all locations we serve, including Tacoma, Bonney Lake, and surrounding neighborhoods.

Get in touch through our Contact Us page to request a quote or schedule service.

Panel Upgrades

Burien Electrician Panel Change Services Near You

If your electrical panel is outdated, overloaded, or frequently tripping, it’s time for a professional upgrade. Washington Electrical LLC provides expert panel change services in Burien, WA, offering modern solutions that improve your home’s safety and power capacity.

 

EV Charger

Installing an EV charger at your home or business in Burien? Washington Electrical LLC makes it simple. Our certified electricians provide safe, efficient EV charger installations that integrate seamlessly with your existing electrical system.

We can also help determine whether your home requires a panel upgrade before installation to handle increased load capacity. Located near Renton, we proudly serve Burien residents with high-quality, affordable residential electrical solutions.

Lighting Upgrades

Brighten and modernize your Burien home with professional lighting installation by Washington Electrical LLC. Whether you want to enhance curb appeal, upgrade interior fixtures, or increase energy efficiency, our team delivers clean, code-compliant results every time.

Imagine transforming a dark or outdated space into a warm, inviting room that reflects your style and comfort. Combine your new lighting setup with a panel or wiring upgrade for a complete home improvement package.

Wiring Upgrades

Modern homes demand reliable electrical systems. Our home wiring upgrades in Burien, WA are designed to improve safety, efficiency, and long-term performance. Outdated or damaged wiring can cause flickering lights, tripped breakers, or even fire hazards — upgrading ensures your system keeps up with today’s technology.

Our electricians can pair your wiring project with lighting installation, panel replacement, or EV charger setup for a full-service solution. Trust Washington Electrical LLC to bring your home up to code and power it safely for years to come.

Outlet Install

Enhance convenience and functionality in your Burien home with new outlets professionally installed by Washington Electrical LLC. Adding or relocating outlets can eliminate clutter, make daily life easier, and increase overall safety.

We strategically install outlets in kitchens, living rooms, garages, and outdoor spaces to meet your household needs. Combine this service with lighting or wiring upgrades for a modern, efficient home powered by professionals you can count on.

Service Call

Keep your home’s electrical system running smoothly with a service call in Burien, WA from Washington Electrical LLC. If you’re dealing with flickering lights, faulty switches, or circuit issues, our experienced electricians can quickly diagnose and fix the problem before it becomes costly or unsafe.

We handle everything from panel inspections to lighting repairs, always putting your home’s safety first. Choose Washington Electrical for dependable service, clear communication, and quality you can trust.

Your Trusted Electrician in South King County

Washington Electrical Company provides top-quality electrical services for homes and businesses in South King County, Washington.

Get a Free Quote!

About Washington Electrical Company

With over 10 years of experience, Washington Electrical Company is your go-to licensed and insured electrician in South King County, Washington. We pride ourselves on delivering safe, efficient, and reliable electrical solutions for residential clients. From wiring upgrades to emergency repairs, our certified electricians are committed to exceeding your expectations.

Our Electrical Services in South King County

We offer a full range of electrical services tailored to the unique needs of South King County residents:

  • Residential electrical installations and repairs
  • Residential wiring repair
  • Custom lighting design and installation
  • Electrical panel upgrades for modern homes
  • EV charger installations for eco-friendly living
  • Emergency electrical services

All our work complies with King County and Washington state electrical codes, ensuring safety and quality.

Why Choose Washington Electrical Company?

  • Experienced Professionals: Our certified electricians have years of expertise.
  • Availability: Emergency electrical services when you need them most.
  • Competitive Pricing: Transparent quotes with no hidden fees.
  • Local Expertise: Proudly serving Auburn, Federal Way, Kent, Renton, and other South King County areas.
  • Customer Satisfaction: We prioritize safety and quality in every project.

Your Trusted Electrician in Pierce County

Washington Electrical delivers reliable electrical services for homes and businesses in Pierce County, Washington.

Get a Free Quote!

About Washington Electrical Company

Washington Electrical Company is a licensed and insured electrical contractor serving Pierce County, Washington, with over a decade of experience. Our certified electricians provide safe, efficient, and high-quality electrical services for residential clients. As your reliable electricians, we guarantee prompt and professional service for every job. Whether it’s a new installation, routine maintenance, or urgent repairs, we’re your trusted partner in Pierce County.

Our Electrical Services in Pierce County

We offer comprehensive electrical services customized for Pierce County homes:

  • Residential electrical installations and repairs

  • Electrical system maintenance and wiring

  • Custom lighting design and installation

  • Electrical panel upgrades for enhanced safety

  • EV charger installations for sustainable living

  • Emergency electrical services

All our work adheres to Pierce County and Washington state electrical codes, ensuring safety and reliability.

Why Choose Washington Electrical Company?

  • Certified Expertise: Our electricians are highly trained and experienced.

  • Emergency Services: We’re available whenever you need us.

  • Transparent Pricing: Competitive rates with free, no-obligation quotes.

  • Local Knowledge: Serving Tacoma, Puyallup, Lakewood, Gig Harbor, and other Pierce County communities.

  • Customer-First Approach: Your satisfaction and safety are our priorities.

  • Seattle

Business Hours

Monday - Saturday: Open 24 hours

Sunday: Closed

Is Your Panel Safe? Common Signs You Need an Upgrade or Repair:

  • Frequent Tripping: Circuit breakers reset constantly.
  • Flickering Lights: Lights dim when appliances turn on.
  • Burnt Odors/Sparks: Smelling burning plastic or seeing sparks (immediate safety concern).
  • Old/Outdated Panel: Still using fuses or a FPE/Zinsco brand panel.

item.content:encoded:
Electrical Panel Repair & Upgrade Experts

Stop Fuses & Breakers from Tripping! Fast, Reliable Service from Licensed Washington Electricians.

⚖️ NEC & State Code Compliant.

? Hundreds of  Satisfied Customers 

?️ Inspection Passed. Guaranteed.

A+ BBB Accredited Business

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️  5/5 Google Rating

FREE PANEL PRE-INSPECT

[wpforms id="4595"][grw id=2061] "I’d leave six stars if I could! Ivan was an absolute pleasure to work with, and he and his team did an outstanding job replacing our panel. From the initial estimate, Ivan was punctual, extremely knowledgeable, and generous with sharing tips to help us meet our electrical needs—even beyond the work we had planned..." Erika Foldyna⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ "I would highly recommend Russ and team! They upgraded our electric panel, installed electric patio heaters and other wiring adjustments. They routed all the wiring within complex structures/walls without it being visible. Quality of work and communication was great!" Samant Khanna⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ "Russ and Ivan are the best! They did a great job diagnosing the issue and had very fair and transparent pricing. They do their work with a high quality of standard and triple check everything before leaving. I can’t recommend them enough." Christy Caldwell⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Washington Electrical is Licensed. Bonded. Insured. A+ BBB Rating. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VlYpYWQ6n2w

Why Homeowners Trust Washington Electrical

  • Upfront Pricing: Know the total cost before we start.
  • Local Experts: Serving Seattle, Tacoma, Auburn & surrounding areas for years.
  • 100% Satisfaction Guarantee: We stand behind every job we do.

Is It Time for an Electrical Check-Up? Watch for These Red Flags:

  • Constant Tripping: Your circuit breakers need resetting all the time.
  • Lights Dimming: Lights flicker or dim noticeably when you turn on an appliance.
  • Burning Smells or Sparks: You detect a burning plastic smell or see sparks—this requires immediate professional attention!
  • Outdated Hardware: Your home still uses fuses instead of modern breakers, or you have a known hazardous brand like FPE or Zinsco.

Don't Risk Electrical Fires: Schedule Your Panel Service Today!

Request a Quote Today

Contact Information

Call: (253) 234-5359

Text: (253) 234-5219

Business Hours

Monday - Saturday: Open 24 hours

Sunday: Closed

Call Now!

item.title: privacy-policy
item.dc:creator: ruslan
item.content:encoded:
Privacy Policy – Washington Electrical LLC

Effective date: October 19, 2025

Washington Electrical LLC (“we,” “us,” or “our”) operates washingtonelectrical.net.

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect information in connection with our website, quote forms, and customer communication.

Information We Collect

  • Contact details: name, email, phone, address, ZIP.
  • Project details: service type, description, property info.
  • Website data: cookies, IP, browser, pages visited, and interactions.
  • Advertising/analytics data: through Google Ads and Google Analytics.

How We Use Information

  • Provide estimates, schedule service, and respond to inquiries.
  • Improve our website, marketing, and customer experience.
  • Comply with legal requirements and prevent fraud.
  • Send occasional updates or promotions (opt-out anytime).

Cookies & Tracking

We use cookies and similar tools to measure website performance and ad effectiveness.

You can manage cookies in your browser or learn more at adssettings.google.com.

Sharing of Information

We do not sell personal information. We may share limited data with:

  • Service providers (hosting, analytics, payment, scheduling).
  • Legal authorities when required by law.
  • Business transfers in the event of a merger or sale.

Data Retention

Information is kept only as long as necessary for business, warranty, or legal purposes.

Your Choices

  • Request to view or update your information.
  • Opt out of marketing emails anytime.
  • Adjust cookie settings in your browser.

Security

We use reasonable administrative, technical, and physical measures to protect information, though no method is 100 % secure.

Children’s Privacy

Our services are not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect their information.

Updates

We may update this policy from time to time. The effective date above shows the latest version.

Contact Us

Washington Electrical LLC

Fife, Washington  ·  Pierce County

? (253) 234-5359

✉️ service@washingtonelectrical.net

? https://washingtonelectrical.net/staging/3532/

item.title: Emergency Electrician near Tacoma: Washington Electrical LLC Light the way
item.dc:creator: ruslan
item.content:encoded:
Date: March 10, 2025

When an electrical emergency strikes, you need a trusted emergency electrician near me—fast. At Washington Electrical LLC, a family-owned company serving Tacoma and beyond, we’re here to bring reliable, professional solutions to your doorstep. Whether it’s a sparking outlet, a power outage, or a wiring crisis, our local electricians are ready to light the way.

Why Choose Washington Electrical LLC for Emergencies?

Electrical issues don’t wait for a convenient time, and neither do we. As your go-to electrician near Tacoma, here’s what sets us apart:

  • Round-the-Clock Service: Day or night, our electrical contractors near me respond quickly to emergencies.
  • Trusted Local Pros: We’re a Tacoma-based team with a reputation for excellence—just ask our happy customers!
  • Fast & Fair: From troubleshooting over the phone to on-site fixes, we prioritize efficiency and transparency.

Take it from Mike Johnson (March 6, 2025):
“Had issues with GFI breakers popping. Russ came out that evening… confirmed the wiring was ok, swapped the breakers right then. Great service! Recommend calling him for your electrical needs!”

What’s an Electrical Emergency?

Not sure if you need an emergency electrician near me? Call us if you’re dealing with:

  • Sparks or Burning Smells: A potential fire hazard requiring immediate action.
  • Power Loss: When it’s not a utility issue, we’ll find the cause.
  • Tripped Breakers That Won’t Reset: Could signal a serious problem.

Carrie Stark (February 23, 2025) raved:
“Russ and his partner were punctual, polite, and hardworking… figured out how to bring my 1986 house up to code without permits. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Washington Electrical, LLC!”

Beyond Emergencies: Full-Service Electricians

While we excel as your emergency electrician near me, we’re also experts in routine electrical work. From panel upgrades to EV charger installations, our local electricians handle it all. Need a backup power solution? Lonnie Herring (February 9, 2025) said:
“Russ installed a battery storage unit… explained options simply and clearly. Now I feel ready when the power goes out.”

Serving Tacoma and Surrounding Areas

Searching for an electrician near Tacoma? Washington Electrical LLC is proud to be your neighborhood electrical pros. Whether it’s an urgent fix or a planned upgrade, our skilled electrical contractors near me deliver top-notch service at fair prices. For those exploring other local options, Kanon Electric, another trusted Tacoma-area electrician since 2006, also offers residential services like panel upgrades and troubleshooting—perfect for comparing your choices in the region.

Searching for an electrician near Tacoma? Washington Electrical LLC is proud to be your neighborhood electrical pros. Whether it’s an urgent fix or a planned upgrade, our skilled electrical contractors near me deliver top-notch service at fair prices.

Joe McLaughlin (October 24, 2024) shared:
“Russ tried troubleshooting my GFCI issue over the phone… came out quickly when I couldn’t fix it. Price was very reasonable!”

Call Your Local Electrician Today

Don’t risk DIY fixes in an emergency—let the experts at Washington Electrical LLC handle it. Contact us 24/7 at 253-2345359 or visit https://washingtonelectrical.net/staging/3532/ to request a quote. We’re your emergency electrician near me, ready to keep your home safe and powered.

item.title: Cost of Electrical Panel Installation in Washington State
item.dc:creator: ruslan
item.content:encoded:
As a homeowner in Washington State, ensuring your electrical system is up to date and safe is crucial. At Washington Electrical, we specialize in electrical panel installations and upgrades, helping you power your home efficiently and securely. In this blog post, we'll break down the costs associated with electrical panel installation, the factors that influence those prices, and why investing in a new panel might be the right choice for you.

Factors Affecting the Cost of Electrical Panel Installation

Your electrical panel, often called a breaker box, is the heart of your home's electrical system. It distributes power from the utility company to various circuits throughout your property. Over time, older panels can become outdated, especially with the increasing demand from modern appliances, electric vehicles, and smart home devices.

Common reasons for installation or upgrade include:

  • Frequent circuit breaker trips or flickering lights.
  • Adding new appliances or home expansions.
  • Compliance with current electrical codes for safety.
  • Preparing for solar panels or EV chargers.

Upgrading your panel not only enhances safety but also increases your property's value and energy efficiency.

What is an Electrical Panel and Why Install or Upgrade One?

Several variables can impact the total cost of installing or upgrading an electrical panel. Understanding these can help you budget effectively:

  • Panel Size and Amperage: Panels range from 100 to 400 amps. A basic 100-amp upgrade might cost less, while a 200-amp or higher panel for larger homes will be more expensive due to increased capacity. More amps generally mean higher costs.
  • Complexity of the Installation: If your existing wiring needs significant updates or if the panel location is hard to access (e.g., in a basement or behind walls), labor costs will rise. Additional work like rewiring circuits or grounding can add to the expense.
  • Location and Permits: In Washington State, cities like Seattle or Auburn may require specific permits, which can add $100–$500 to the project. Local market rates also play a role—urban areas like Seattle tend to have higher labor costs compared to rural parts of the state.
  • Brand and Type of Panel: High-quality brands or smart panels with advanced features (e.g., surge protection) cost more than basic models.
  • Existing System Condition: Older homes (pre-1960s) might need more extensive work to meet modern codes, increasing costs.
  • Additional Features: Installing sub-panels for specific areas (like a garage) or integrating with renewable energy systems can bump up the price.

Benefits of Investing in a New Electrical Panel

While the upfront cost might seem daunting, the long-term advantages make it worthwhile:

  • Improved Safety: Reduces risks of electrical fires from overloaded circuits.
  • Energy Efficiency: Modern panels handle power more effectively, potentially lowering your utility bills.
  • Future-Proofing: Supports additions like EV chargers, home offices, or solar installations.
  • Increased Home Value: Buyers prioritize updated electrical systems.

At Washington Electrical, we've helped countless clients in the Puget Sound area upgrade their panels, resulting in peace of mind and reliable power.

Ready to Upgrade? Contact Washington Electrical Today

If you're experiencing electrical issues or planning a home improvement project, don't wait—schedule a consultation with our licensed electricians. We offer competitive pricing, transparent quotes, and top-notch service tailored to Washington State's codes and climate.

item.title: Why GFCI Outlets Are the Top Reason Homeowners Call Electricians in Fife
item.dc:creator: ruslan
item.content:encoded:
Why GFCIs Cause So Many Electrical Service Calls

As experienced Fife electricians, we’ve found that one of the most common reasons homeowners call us is because their outlets suddenly stop working—and more often than not, the culprit is a tripped GFCI outlet.

What Is a GFCI Outlet?

A Ground Fault Circuit Interrupter (GFCI) outlet is designed to protect you from electrical shock by shutting off power when it detects a ground fault. You can identify a GFCI by the “Test” and “Reset” buttons on its face. They are typically located in areas with moisture, such as bathrooms, kitchens, garages, and outdoor spaces.

Why a Tripped GFCI Affects Multiple Outlets

Many homeowners don’t realize that a single GFCI outlet can control multiple outlets throughout the house. For example:

  • A bathroom GFCI may also control outlets in a nearby bedroom.

  • A garage GFCI might control exterior plugs or basement outlets.

  • A kitchen GFCI could be wired to multiple countertop or dining area outlets.

When the GFCI trips, all outlets connected to it lose power—even if they’re in a completely different room.

The Most Common Issue: Forgetting to Press “Reset”

It’s easy to assume an outlet is broken when it stops working, but often the fix is as simple as pressing the “Reset” buttonon your GFCI. Many homeowners overlook this step and end up calling for service unnecessarily. Still, if your GFCI won’t reset or keeps tripping, that could indicate a wiring problem or a moisture-related fault that needs professional attention.

How to Troubleshoot GFCIs at Home

Before calling a licensed electrician:

  1. Check all GFCI outlets in your home (bathroom, kitchen, garage, outdoors).

  2. Press the “Reset” button on each one, even if it doesn’t seem related to the affected area.

  3. Plug in a small device (like a phone charger) to test if power returns.

If outlets are still not working after checking all GFCIs, it’s time to call your trusted Fife electricians for diagnosis.

Professional Help When You Need It

At Washington Electrical LLC, our experienced team has handled countless calls where a simple GFCI reset solved the issue. But when deeper electrical troubleshooting is needed, we’re ready to ensure your system is safe and up to code.

Call Washington Electrical LLC today if your outlets aren’t working or your GFCI keeps tripping. Our licensed electricians proudly serve Fife, Tacoma, and surrounding Pierce County areas with fast, professional electrical service.
